title: Convert Mindmap Cluster To Dsl Derive Engine
description: Convert the reasoning/mindmap 3-crate cluster (reasoning_mindmap, reasoning_mindmap_wires, reasoning-mindmap-plugin) off their hand-rolled DocumentDsl/OpText parser onto the declarative dsl:: derive engine, following the accumulated dsl:: conversion cheat sheet: add derives, regenerate the shared metabolism.wires fixture via the mandated procedure, delete the old hand-rolled parser module, and confirm all three crates' test suites stay green.
summary:
Converted the reasoning/mindmap 3-crate cluster off its hand-rolled DocumentDsl/OpText parser onto the declarative dsl:: derive engine, in dependency order.

reasoning_mindmap (crate #1, owns the document/DSL parser): added `dsl` dependency; `#[derive(dsl::DslDocument)]` (extension="wires", layout="lines") directly on `MindmapWiresDocument` with `#[dsl(key="wires")]`/`#[dsl(key="board")]` on its two `serde_json::Value` fields (bind via the engine's built-in `Shape::Value` escape hatch, no local mirror type needed); `#[derive(dsl::DslOps)]` directly on `MindmapWiresOperation` with kebab-case `#[dsl(key=...)]` per variant matching the old op-text vocabulary. Followed the mandatory fixture regen procedure exactly: kept `mod mindmap_text` callable while deleting only the old `impl vcs::DocumentDsl`/`impl vcs::OpText` blocks, added a temporary test that parsed `wires/example/metabolism.wires` with the old parser, printed via the new derive, wrote the file back, reparsed with the new derive and asserted equality (modulo `serde_json::Number`'s int/float representation — the engine's `DslValue::Number` is a single f64, a documented normalization, not a bug), confirmed it passed, then deleted the temp test and the entire `mod mindmap_text` together. Fixed one test (`op_text_round_trip_add_relationship`) whose JSON fixture used integer literals that no longer round-trip byte-identically; switched to float literals. Left `MindmapWiresDiff` untouched (internal `OperationDiff` type, never DSL-text-facing, per the cheat sheet).

reasoning_mindmap_wires (crate #2): no DSL parser of its own and no new types needed deriving (its `RelationshipKind` enum is never embedded in the document's JSON, only reconstructed internally). Fixed a real bug the fixture regen surfaced: `DefaultWiresExtension::from_fixture_json`'s `.as_u64()` calls on `identityId`/`relationshipId` returned `None` once those fields round-trip through the new engine as floats (`Number(1.0)` instead of `Number(1)`), silently hydrating an empty extension. Added a local `json_id` helper (tries `as_u64` then falls back to `as_f64` cast) and used it at both call sites.

reasoning-mindmap-plugin (crate #3): pure UI/app satellite, no document of its own. Proactively fixed the same latent `.as_u64()` bug in `identity_label`/`wires_relationship_document_label` (silently swallowed by `Option` chains, not caught by existing assertions, but real) with an equivalent local `json_id` helper.

Verified with `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/claude-mindmap-dslconv-target cargo test -p reasoning_mindmap -p reasoning_mindmap_wires -p reasoning-mindmap-plugin`:
- reasoning_mindmap: 12 passed, 0 failed
- reasoning_mindmap_wires: 4 passed, 0 failed
- reasoning-mindmap-plugin: 15 passed, 0 failed (14 real tests + 1 plugin bundle-manifest sanity check)
All 31 tests green, no compile warnings introduced by this conversion (only pre-existing, unrelated warnings remain, e.g. `RelationshipKind`/`LocaleLabels` unused imports in the plugin crate that predate this change). Also sanity-checked the one downstream consumer outside the assigned 3 crates, `puzzle_2d` (which does `pub use reasoning_mindmap as mindmap;`), still compiles clean.
